title: Administrative Closure of Wound Care Programs — Closure Reasons
content:
# Administrative closure — Wound Care Supply Program

Register of the cases in which Larkfield closes a wound care program administratively.

## The register

A program closes administratively, with the matching closure reason, in exactly these cases:

| Closure reason | Case |
|---|---|
| documentation not received | a program still in referral received or pending authorization, once the date of the write is later than the enrolled date plus the referral documentation window, in calendar days, with no prior authorization decision pending |
| authorization denied | a payer prior authorization denial stands and no new request is pending |
| hold limit reached | a program on hold, once the date of the write is later than the hold start date plus the tier's longest hold, in calendar days |
| coverage ended | a program on hold for coverage lapse whose customer reports no replacement coverage |
| customer discontinued | the customer confirms the cancellation of a program on hold |
| deceased | Larkfield's records team has recorded the customer's death |

Day counts in this register are calendar days counted from the named date, and a closure is made only on a day strictly later than the named date plus the stated days. No case outside the register closes a program administratively.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical dates)

*Referral documentation window of 30 days, enrolled date 2026-04-06.* The enrolled date plus 30 days is 2026-05-06.

| Date of the write | Documentation not received closure |
|---|---|
| 2026-05-06 | No — not strictly later than 2026-05-06 |
| 2026-05-07 | Yes, if the program is still in referral received or pending authorization with no prior authorization decision pending |

*Longest hold of 60 days, hold start date 2026-03-01.* The hold start date plus 60 days is 2026-04-30.

| Date of the write | Hold limit reached closure |
|---|---|
| 2026-04-30 | No — not strictly later than 2026-04-30 |
| 2026-05-01 | Yes, if the program is still on hold |

## Points of judgement

- A program in pending authorization past its referral documentation window, but with a prior authorization decision still pending, is not closed as documentation not received.
- A program on hold for coverage lapse closes as coverage ended only when its customer reports no replacement coverage.
